In Practice
What an engagement looks like.
A specialty pharma company needed to reconcile MIDAS, CRM and field data across four EU markets. Three data sources were telling three different stories about market share. We built a unified commercial view inside their existing Power BI environment in six weeks. No new platform. No additional licence. The same team continues to evolve the intelligence as new commercial questions emerge.
FAQ
Questions buyers usually ask.
What is commercial intelligence in life sciences?
It is the layer that connects market data, field activity and scientific evidence to the commercial decisions a pharma or biopharma team needs to make. Tecera combines governed data, domain analytics and continuous delivery rather than treating each source as a separate report.
What does a Forward-Deployed Consultant do in pharma?
They work directly with the commercial team, understand the business question, build analytics or applications inside the client's existing environment, and remain involved as the intelligence evolves. The role combines pharma commercial context, hands-on analytics and technical delivery.
Can Tecera work with our existing Veeva, Power BI, Snowflake or Databricks environment?
Yes. The model is intentionally stack-agnostic. Tecera can work from flat files and existing BI through to modern cloud and agentic environments without forcing a platform migration.
How is Tecera different from a typical analytics consultancy or software platform?
Tecera operates as a continuous intelligence function. We do not require a new platform licence and we do not treat delivery as a one-off analytics project. The same team can diagnose, build, deploy and evolve the intelligence with the client.
Where does AI fit into the Tecera model?
AI is applied only where the commercial decision benefits from it, for example forecasting, NLP, literature monitoring or pattern detection at scale. The foundation and domain logic come first.

## About
URL: https://tecerabiz.com/about

Who We Are
Forward-Deployed Consultants.
Commercial analysts who understand both the legacy and the modern stack. Tecera works directly on commercial questions, data and analytical delivery. Our current depth is in life sciences, with experience spanning commercial analytics, market intelligence, field effectiveness and applied technology across EMEA, the US and India.
What We Believe
Commercial data is often underused .
The problem is rarely access alone. Teams need the business context, analytical logic and technical execution to turn available data into something commercially useful.
Data without context is noise
A performance change means little without understanding what changed in the market, execution or underlying evidence.
The question comes before the technology
We define the commercial question first, then determine the data, analysis and technology required to answer it.
AI has to earn its place
AI is useful when it improves the analysis, workflow or output. It is not the starting point.
Our Background
Over a decade working alongside pharma commercial leaders .
The team behind Tecera has worked inside and alongside six life sciences commercial organisations across rare disease, specialty care, ophthalmology and HAE. That experience covers market intelligence, field analytics, KOL engagement, forecasting and applied technology. Every engagement we take on is informed by that context.

We are building a small expert team that wants to work directly on business questions, data and analytical delivery.

## Privacy Policy
URL: https://tecerabiz.com/privacy-policy

Legal
Privacy Policy
Last Modified: September 04, 2026
Note: Tecera Business Solutions is currently operating as a trading name pending formal incorporation. Company registration details will be updated in this policy upon completion of that process. For any queries in the interim, contact us at info@tecerabiz.com .
1. Who We Are
Tecera is a commercial analytics consultancy trading as Tecera Business Solutions (registration number: [to be inserted upon incorporation] ), 690, 12th Cross Road, 7th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560070, India. We provide data analytics, market intelligence and commercial decision support services to life sciences organisations.
For the purposes of this policy, Tecera is the data controller for personal data collected through this website. For questions about this policy or your data, contact us at info@tecerabiz.com .
2. What Data We Collect
When you submit an enquiry through our contact form, we collect the following personal data:
Full name
Work email address
Company name
The content of your message or enquiry
We do not collect sensitive personal data. We do not use tracking cookies, analytics scripts or advertising technologies on this website.
3. How We Use Your Data
We use the information you submit solely to respond to your enquiry and, where relevant, to assess whether and how Tecera can support your commercial needs. We will not use your data for marketing communications without your explicit consent, and we will not add you to any mailing list based on a single form submission.
4. Legal Basis for Processing
For visitors based in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, our legal basis for processing your personal data is your consent, given when you tick the consent checkbox and submit the form. You may withdraw that consent at any time by contacting us at the address above.
For all other visitors, processing is based on our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries.
5. How Long We Keep Your Data
We retain enquiry data for a maximum of 24 months from the date of submission, or until you request deletion, whichever is sooner. If an engagement begins, data relevant to that engagement is retained for the duration of the relationship and for a period of 5 years thereafter, in line with standard business record-keeping requirements.
6. Who We Share Your Data With
We do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. Enquiry data submitted via this form is received directly by the Tecera team. We do not use third-party CRM platforms, email marketing tools or data brokers in connection with this form.
In the event that Tecera is required to disclose data by law, regulation or court order, we will comply with that obligation and notify you where legally permitted to do so.
7. Your Rights
If you are based in the EEA, UK or Switzerland, you have the following rights in relation to your personal data:
Access: the right to request a copy of the data we hold about you.
Correction: the right to request that inaccurate data be corrected.
Deletion: the right to request that we delete your data.
Restriction: the right to request that we restrict processing of your data.
Portability: the right to receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Objection: the right to object to processing based on legitimate interest.
To exercise any of these rights, contact us at info@tecerabiz.com . We will respond within 30 days. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
8. Data Security
Enquiries submitted through this form are transmitted via encrypted connection (HTTPS). We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal data from unauthorised access, loss or disclosure. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, but we apply industry-standard protections appropriate to the type of data we handle.
9. International Transfers
Tecera operates from India. When you submit an enquiry from the EEA or UK, your data is transferred to and processed in India. We rely on your consent as the transfer mechanism for this cross-border processing. If you have questions about international data transfers, contact us at the address above.
10. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. We encourage you to review this page periodically. Continued use of this website after a revision constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
11. Contact
For any questions, requests or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data:
Tecera Business Solutions
Registration No: [to be inserted upon incorporation]
690, 12th Cross Road, 7th Block, Jayanagar
Bengaluru, Karnataka 560070, India
